ATX heading style produces hash-prefixed headings

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, HeadingStyle, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<h1>Title</h1><h2>Subtitle</h2>"
    options = ConversionOptions(heading_style=HeadingStyle("Atx"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
